title: Tiki Tiki: The Tropical Memory Game
description:
Big free update on December 1, 2026Tiki Tiki first came out in 2020, and it is being rebuilt for 2026: a new hand-carved look, a brand-new fourth game (Totem Recall), medals and trials to win, a smoother interface and full controller support. It arrives on December 1 as a free update for everyone who owns the game.

Three relaxing puzzles, one tropical island🌴Twin Peeks (Pairs) — Memorize where each card is before they turn over. Can you find every pair?

🌴Twist of Face (Twister) — Watch closely: each tiki turns to one side. Repeat the sequence, right tiki and right direction.

🌴Tiki Says (Sparkle) — The tikis light up one after another. Repeat the sequence in the same order.

Three sizes and two rules for each game, for short, relaxing sessions.
description_short: Tiki Tiki gets a big free update on December 1, 2026: a new hand-carved look, a fourth game, medals to win and full controller support. Until then, enjoy three relaxing puzzle games on a tropical island: find the pairs, follow the turns and follow the lights.
